title: 第17章 凝聚血纹灵剑宗四长老第18章 秒杀四长老册立圣子
content_zh:
第17章凝聚血纹，灵剑宗四长老
“什么情况？”
虚空颤动，血衣男子再度浮现而出，太苍武王又来了。
此刻的太苍武王，表情极为夸张，震惊无比。
这可是万里血河掌，他的成名绝学，咋可能，林尘一天就学会了？
掌心凝聚出血纹，便是万里血河掌修炼成功的标志。
这才一天，就算有太苍武王提供的一滴武王精血，林尘也不可能这么快就练成啊！
吸收武王精血的速度快也就罢了，悟性还如此之高，简直恐怖如斯！
林尘有些无语。
太苍武王只是一道残魂，之前他消失，林尘还以为他是彻底消散了。
“前辈，你不是走了吗？”
林尘摊了摊手。
“我本来快要消散了，被你吓得重新凝聚残魂。”
太苍武王感慨道。
林尘：“……”
“圣主，您有如此传人，我大禹皇朝可兴啊！”
“少主，老奴去也，这大禹皇朝的未来，就交给你了。”
太苍武王说完，身形再度消散。
“前辈，真走了啊？要不留下来，咱俩再聊聊。”
林尘很热情。

这可是太苍武王，说不定还能从他身上压榨出宝贝来。
但，太苍武王并没有再回应。
林尘摇了摇头，大禹皇朝的未来如何，他可顾不上。
还是顾好当下，努力修炼。
不多时，柳嫣然苏醒过来。
看到林尘身边血光环绕，顿时美眸一凝，不明所以。
“嫣然，你醒了。”
林尘收了血河，微微一笑。
万里血河掌修炼有成，他可凝聚出一条血河，如今血河规模不大，如一道血色圆环，不过威力也很惊人了。
“嗯，林公子，我们没事了吗？”
柳嫣然打量着四周的环境，发现血河已经干涸，心中惊讶不已。
“没事了，我们随时可以离开血灵渊。”
“此地危险，我们现在就走吧。”
content_en:
Chapter 17 Condensing Blood Patterns, the Four Elders of the Spirit Sword Sect
"What's going on?"
The void trembled, and the man in blood reappeared. King Tai Cang Wu came again.
At this moment, Tai Cang Martial King's expression was extremely exaggerated and extremely shocked.
This is the Wanli Blood River Palm, his famous secret skill. How is it possible that Lin Chen learned it in one day?
The accumulation of bleeding lines in the palm is a sign of successful practice in Wanli Blood River Palm.
It had only been one day, and even with a drop of King Wu's essence and blood provided by King Tai Cang, Lin Chen wouldn't have been able to master it so quickly!
It's just that he can absorb King Wu's essence and blood quickly, but his understanding is so high, it's simply terrifying!
Lin Chen was speechless.
King Tai Cang Wu was just a remnant soul. Before he disappeared, Lin Chen thought he had completely dissipated.
"Senior, aren't you leaving?"
Lin Chen spread his hands.
"I was about to dissipate, but you scared me into regrouping my remaining soul."
King Taicang Wu said with emotion.
Lin Chen: "..."
"Holy Lord, if you have such a successor, our Dynasty of Dayu will be prosperous!"
"Young Master, this old slave is leaving. The future of the Yu Dynasty will be left to you."
After King Taicang Wu finished speaking, his figure disappeared again.
"Senior, are you really leaving? Why don't you stay and let's talk again."
Lin Chen was very enthusiastic.
This is Tai Cang Martial King, maybe even treasures can be squeezed out of him.
However, King Taicang Wu did not respond.
Lin Chen shook his head. He didn't care about the future of the Yu Dynasty.
It’s better to take care of the present moment and practice hard.
Not long after, Liu Yanran woke up.
Seeing the blood surrounding Lin Chen, his beautiful eyes suddenly condensed, not knowing why.
"Yanran, you're awake."
Lin Chen collected the blood river and smiled slightly.
After successfully practicing the Wanli Blood River Palm, he can condense a blood river. The blood river is now small in size, like a bloody ring, but its power is also amazing.
"Well, Mr. Lin, are we okay?"
Liu Yanran looked at her surroundings and was surprised to find that the blood river had dried up.
"It's okay, we can leave the Blood Spirit Abyss at any time."
"This place is dangerous, let's leave now."
